pages.text: Kitsunebi Light (Fox Fire) is an invisible light. Use it against a block for normal placement, or use it in the air to toss Kitsunebi Light and place it where it lands. $(br2) Feed the fox Abura-age Tofu Pouch to generate Kitunebi Light, and give other items to the fox to get the Kitsunebi Light from its mouth.$(br2)In order to use it, a Fire Element Magatama with 10 or more stored Reiryoku in the inventory is needed.
Only when the Kitsunebi Light is held in the hand, flame particles appear at the locations of the nearby Kitsunebi Lights to confirm the positions.
